page_title: ROM 1-1 JUV | AS Roma v Juventus 06/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+1' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) is penalised for a foul. Andrea Colombo had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
89' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Weston McKennie (Juventus). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
85' The referee allows time for a substitution. Artem Dovbyk will be replaced by Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma).
84' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
82' The AS Roma players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
76' Igor Tudor decides to make a substitution. Manuel Locatelli will be replaced by Nicolo Savona (Juventus).
75' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle and it's Khephren Thuram (Juventus) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
72' Here comes a substitution. Victor Nelsson (AS Roma) is brought on as a substitute for Zeki Celik.
72' Juventus take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
72' What a great touch by Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom right corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
69' Igor Tudor has decided to make a change. Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) replaces Nicolas Gonzalez.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) comes onto the pitch so that Timothy Weah can be given a rest.
68' Here is a change. Dusan Vlahovic is going off and Igor Tudor gives the last tactical orders to Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus).
65' The game has begun to heat up. Renato Veiga (Juventus) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
62' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Juventus comes to nothing.
61' It is time for a substitution. Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is on for Bryan Cristante.
61' Claudio Ranieri has decided to substitute Stephan El Shaarawy and he is replaced by Lucas Gourna-Douath (AS Roma).

60' That didn't go as planned! Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Michele Di Gregorio, who easily kept it out.
59' The resulting set piece from Juventus is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
58' Timothy Weah (Juventus) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Now Juventus have a corner.

58' Juventus are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
53' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Michele Di Gregorio.

49' 1 - 1 The goalkeeper makes a save but the ball rebounds off him out to Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma). He finds himself some space inside the penalty area and unleashes an unstoppable shot which bounces in off the crossbar. A magnificent goal!
49' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to AS Roma.
48' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
47' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Claudio Ranieri has made a change at the break. Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) has come on in place of Mats Hummels.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Angelino (AS Roma) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
45' AS Roma can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The referee points to the corner flag and AS Roma will take a corner.

40' 0 - 1 Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight into the bottom left corner. He couldn't have done it any better. 0:1.

37' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) latches on to a cross around the penalty spot and produces a bullet header towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper leaps like a salmon and deflects the ball onto the post. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
37' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus).

32' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) was close to scoring from the resulting free kick. He unleashed a decent strike from the edge of the box towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper made a comfortable save to keep him out.
32' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) brings an opponent down and Andrea Colombo interrupts the game. Juventus earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
31' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) commits a foul and Andrea Colombo immediately signals a free kick.
27' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the bar!
26' This is a yellow card! Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
25' AS Roma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
21' AS Roma keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
16' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
11' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Andrea Colombo blows for a foul.
10' Juventus are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
9' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Mile Svilar comes off the line to clear the ball away.
8' A pass from Khephren Thuram (Juventus) is intercepted by Mile Svilar and the move breaks down.
5' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
4' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

3' Timothy Weah (Juventus) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Mile Svilar stops the ball out of the bottom right corner. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
2' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
1' The first half has started.
Juventus will kick the game off.
Andrea Colombo is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
